notes: Evaluates /cadence-sync-youtrack contracts: self-hosted YouTrack Server direct REST (curl -K- token, never argv/logs or signed attachment URL leaks), §9 syncyt.resolve.tracker + inner-source 0-call skip, 2xx read-back verification (syncyt.write.field_not_applied), internal issue_id from Step 5 onward, append-only worklog_watermark_at, and yt-import ceiling fail-closed.

evals.name: inner-source-skip-and-2xx-readback-contract
evals.prompt: Sync ticket BTG-15 when §9 binds youtrack (and separately when §9 resolves to None -- inner-source), verifying a custom field write after HTTP 200.
evals.expected_output: Emits syncyt.resolve.tracker before contacting YouTrack (or logs inner-source skip with zero network calls when §9 is None); uses native Markdown with no AC custom field or umbrella flow; verifies field writes via immediate read-back emitting syncyt.write.field_not_applied if dropped despite HTTP 200.
assertions: Resolves CADENCE_ORG.md#tracker-binding and emits syncyt.resolve.tracker prior to network calls (0 calls for inner-source)
Verifies custom-field updates via read-back rather than trusting HTTP 200 alone
Uses internal issue_id from Step 5 onward and renders native Markdown without wiki conversion

evals.name: token-url-redaction-watermark-and-single-metadata-write
evals.prompt: Import attachment and sync worklogs while guarding against signed URL leaks and partial halts.
evals.expected_output: Redacts YOUTRACK_TOKEN and pre-signed sign= attachment URLs from logs/errors, fails closed on missing attachment_size_ceiling_mib, treats work items as immutable via worklog_watermark_at, writes metadata.yaml once in yt_apply_metadata_writes on full success, and warns on Step 4 create -> Step 5 halt duplicate-issue window.
assertions: Never logs YOUTRACK_TOKEN or pre-signed attachment download URLs
Fails closed downloading zero attachments when attachment_size_ceiling_mib is absent or invalid
Posts work items append-only using worklog_watermark_at without mutating existing tracker entries
Leaves metadata.yaml un-written on mid-sequence halt while reporting created youtrack_url= in partial report
